card.title: Body tampering after signing (bsh mismatch)
card.description: Signs for ₹1,850, then in-flight man-in-the-middle alters amount to ₹18,500. RFC 8785 body hash fails.
card.prerequisites: Default demo mandate active (BillPal, ACC-001, ₹5,000 cap, ask above ₹4,000).

fixture.message: Calculated canonical SHA-256 body hash does not match DPoP bsh claim
